Map safety equipment and actual operator qualifications. Trace required material quantities/consumables for expandable printer modules.

Qualification requires verified sealed-cycle evidence plus independent product safety/functional evidence.
gates.hold: No unsealed operator repositioning in a claimed one-session build; do not misrepresent pre-staged chips as directly printed. No butter-delivery benchmark, no lab-arm redesign, no physical actuation authority from documentation.

butter_bot_founder_direction.primary_goal: Qualify a printer/process system capable of fabricating the entire simple known-geometry Butter Bot in one manufacturing session, attempting printable pathways for every component.
butter_bot_founder_direction.development_sequence: BB01 baseline component/geometry compatibility; BB02 recursive modularisation; BB03 informed integrated refinement; more iterations as needed; only qualified endpoint receives unversioned Butter Bot name.
not_objectives: Butter delivery as R&D success benchmark
Fixed-base bench-assistant design as BB01 starting target
butter_bot_founder_direction.later_derivative: Specialised desk/bench assistant robotics after Butter Bot manufacturing learning curve
butter_bot_founder_direction.active_founder_question: Should Mark-to-Mark material/component regeneration be a separately measurable named proof-of-concept demonstrator alongside Butter Bot and Bootstrap 4D Printer?
butter_bot_founder_direction.operating_hold: No physical operation, high-risk chemistry, root promotion, deployment or PR merge without separate authority.

single_session_founder_ruling.outer_enclosure: Must remain sealed and unopened from cycle start through cycle completion; any manual opening mid-build terminates qualification as a single session.
allowed_during_seal: robotic tool/material access from pre-staged internal shelves or magazines
automated integration of externally manufactured components such as semiconductor chips, pre-staged without opening the process enclosure
prohibited_mid_cycle: operator opening or de-sealing outer process enclosure
manual assembly/repositioning requiring outer seal breach
single_session_founder_ruling.provenance_requirement: Keep direct-printed content separate from vendor-made or preloaded components; a sealed one-session complete Butter Bot need not be composed of 100% directly printed parts, but all-component printing research remains in scope.
single_session_founder_ruling.cross_product: Design automated tooling/component-access interface for wider product families, not only Butter Bot.

dual_track_station_and_motion.decision: Develop sealed multi-process printer station and motion/kinematics testbed concurrently, hybridising results into one scalable print station.
dual_track_station_and_motion.design_candidate: Secondary internal isolation/process region concept analogous in purpose to multilayer window structures; functions/loads/safety/pressures not yet selected or qualified.
dual_track_station_and_motion.mechanical_priority: Measure and minimise actuator reaction-force transfer, tool vibration, structural resonance, datum drift and settling time.
dual_track_station_and_motion.enclosure: Maintain sealed outer chamber throughout cycle; internal robotic tool swaps/pick-place and external digital communications through appropriately sealed feedthroughs permitted.

approved_scope: engineered vacuum capability in Printer-1 design
engineered positive-pressure capability in Printer-1 design
controlled-gas atmospheres with designed isolation/handling in Printer-1 design
atmosphere_founder_decision.qualification: No pressure chamber, window material, atmosphere switching or physical operating procedure qualified; independent safety engineering and authorisation needed

enclosure_geometry.form: Visibly inspectable elongated rectangular rather than cube-like chamber; supports long, flat objects and slender tall objects by reorientation inside the sealed run.
enclosure_geometry.transparent_materials: Glass or acrylic candidate; no material selected or performance rating established.
enclosure_geometry.dimensions: Not fixed; derive from product bounding volumes, robotic sweep/reach and safety envelope.

printer_generations_founder_input.printer_1: Bootstrap 4D Printer; function-first, full intended CGX 4D feature coverage; cosmetics secondary.
printer_generations_founder_input.printer_2: More visually refined 4D printer made with Bootstrap 4D Printer wherever validated, retaining full defining functional requirements; first of multiple scale/application classes.

bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.name: Bootstrap 4D Printer
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.intent: Function-first first-generation printer; create a refined next generation and scalable family of 4D printers.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.complete_4d_requirement: All attributes defining intended CGX 4D functionality must actually be implemented and experimentally addressed from the initial machine; do not evade hard features. Unsafe, untested capability remains commissioning-held.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.iteration_rule: Capture failures/hiccups and use them to improve processes and follow-on machine design, rather than omitting capabilities.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.next_generation: Refined visually polished printer fabricated via Bootstrap printer to the extent its measured processes support; safety-rated externally made parts remain independently qualified.
classes: Personal DIY expandable low-cost seed kit
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.kit_strategy: Provide minimum SAFE working seed components plus evidenced roadmap for printing/enlarging modules. If self-fabrication infeasible, conventional manufacture/assembly kit is an explicit alternate offer, not mislabeled as printer self-replication.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.material_strategy: Account for heavy/high-material prints with feed-specific stock surplus/starting allowance OR suitable modular refills and material options; calculate mass balance, waste, processing losses and safe storage rather than indiscriminate over-supply.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.redundancy: Include appropriate redundancy, fail-safe and safety provisions for each class based on hazard and reliability assessment.
bootstrap_printer_founder_decision.status_caveat: No completed prototype, validated 4D feature implementation, commercial costing, industrial safety sign-off or physical runtime permission is implied.

parallel_program_and_circularity.poc_role: Bootstrap printer is shared proof-of-concept manufacturing infrastructure for Butter Bot, Mark, Luke and other existing projects; develop in parallel, with separate release gates
parallel_program_and_circularity.sourced_parts: Founder approved sourced certified/qualified modules for DIY kit and bootstrap expansion, alongside ongoing full-printing R&D
parallel_program_and_circularity.kit_learning: Optional guided build journey with exploratory alternatives; measure and present actual available capability
parallel_program_and_circularity.startup_handshake: Discover parts and report per-operation capability and limits; keep verified safe modes available but require adequate protection for hazardous functions
parallel_program_and_circularity.circularity: Upcycle/recycle/upgrade; modular when practicable, embedded when functional; passport and end-of-life plan mandatory for non-removable parts
parallel_program_and_circularity.recovered_first: Prioritise qualified reused/upcycled material and parts; requalify recovered Mark hardware for its target use
parallel_program_and_circularity.aesthetic_priority: Product function and measured performance dominate cosmetics, including solar-energy conversion
parallel_program_and_circularity.independent_identities: No universal colour, appearance, terminology or design identity; each owner lane retains individuality; cross-lane learning is evidence-linked and reviewable
parallel_program_and_circularity.evidence_caveat: No physical demonstration, safe pressure rating, recycling rate, or product certification is implied.
